import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*t + p[3]*np.exp(-t)
    amp = p[4] + p[5]*t + p[6]*t**2 + p[7]/t
    n = p[8] + p[9]*t
    K = np.exp(p[9]*0 + 0.8 + 0.1*t)
    An = np.abs(A)**n
    H = An/(K**n + An)
    return base + amp*H
